name: Big Tex Stone Annual Pumpkin Patch
description: Big Tex Stone Annual Pumpkin Patch is an agritourism farm in 820 Old Hemphill Rd, TX, open to visitors for seasonal picking and farm activities. Offerings follow the growing season, so what is available changes through the year. Check the website for current hours and availability.
